description: SASEA Electricity Demand Data for 2013-2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Oliver G Coombes, Kieran Hunt (Imperial College London). This dataset provides harmonised electricity demand records for twelve South and Southeast Asian (SASEA) countries: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Oman, Philippines, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, and Thailand. The data cover the period 2013–2025, with availability varying by country. Coverage: several countries (BD, BT, IN, MY); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
